mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id FROM workspace_domains WHERE domain_key = #{domainKey} AND active = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (chat_room_id, workspace_member_id, chat, room_name, created) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{myWorkId}, 'GROUP', #{roomName}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select:
SELECT cr.chat_room_id "chatRoomId", cr.room_name "roomName", ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members crm JOIN workspace_members wm ON crm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id WHERE crm.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id AND crm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 ) "participantCount"
FROM chat_rooms cr
-- 채팅방이 속한 워크스페이스 확인 JOIN workspace_members owner_wm ON cr.workspace_member_id = owner_wm.workspace_member_id
-- 현재 로그인 회원이 해당 그룹의 참여자인지 확인 JOIN chat_room_members crm ON cr.chat_room_id = crm.chat_room_id AND crm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_members my_wm ON crm.workspace_member_id = my_wm.workspace_member_id AND my_wm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_domains wd ON my_wm.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y'
WHERE cr.chat = 'GROUP' AND my_wm.member_id = #{loginMemberId} AND owner_wm.workspace_id = my_wm.workspace_id
ORDER BY cr.created DESC, cr.chat_room_id DESC
